answer: Agents bond stake and commit to an epoch Shamir polynomial whose secret is tied to their identity key; Semaphore membership and RLN nullifiers bind messages to that identity. A rate-limit proof allows only the permitted messages. Reusing a nullifier yields distinct polynomial shares, allowing recovery of the key and immediate collateral slashing. “Saffron,” “walnut,” and “sonnet” are illustrative labels, not security assumptions.
